entrypoints.summary: The affected deployment separates HTTP and gRPC client endpoints with --listen-client-http-urls; a client can connect to the gRPC endpoint using a revoked certificate.
In onlyGRPC mode, the gRPC stack owns the TLS handshake and creates its server from the supplied TLS configuration.

affected_components.role: Injects CRL verification into the TLS configuration before creating the gRPC server in the gRPC-only listener path.
Defines the CRL-enforcement callback; the follow-up uses tls.Config.VerifyConnection and checks ConnectionState.PeerCertificates.
Defines the separate-listener revoked-client rejection regression-test contract.

causal_paths.kind: TLS configuration propagation to gRPC-only server

code_slices.fixed: ConfigureCRLVerification is invoked before gRPC server creation in onlyGRPC mode; the later revision installs a VerifyConnection callback that passes PeerCertificates to checkCRL.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The patch comments state that wrapping the listener with a second TLS listener would double-wrap TLS because gRPC owns the handshake in this mode.
code_slices.vulnerable: The pre-fix split gRPC listener did not receive CRL verification in the TLS configuration used by gRPC.

negative_controls: The advisory reports that the HTTP endpoint correctly rejects the same revoked certificate.
The regression-test contract expects the split-listener revoked-client put to fail with an error containing "context deadline exceeded".
observability.positive_marker: Before remediation, the advisory reports successful gRPC authentication with the revoked certificate.

impact.affected_asset: etcd client API and data reachable through the gRPC endpoint.
impact.attacker_capability: Authenticate to the gRPC client endpoint using a revoked client certificate when the HTTP and gRPC listeners are split.
impact.security_effect: Authentication bypass for a client certificate that has been revoked by the configured CRL; the advisory assigns high confidentiality and integrity impacts.

causal_trace.summary: A deployment configures --listen-client-http-urls, separating its HTTP and gRPC client listeners, while a client presents a certificate listed in the configured client CRL.
The CRL is enforced for the HTTP endpoint but not for the separately configured gRPC listener, so revoked-certificate rejection is not applied consistently across client TLS paths.
The gRPC-only path lets gRPC own the TLS handshake without injecting CRL verification into the TLS configuration before gRPC creates and clones that configuration.
The revoked client certificate can still authenticate successfully over gRPC, allowing the holder to access the etcd client API despite CRL revocation.

failure.operation: gRPC TLS handshake and client authentication in onlyGRPC mode

primary_invariant.statement: When a client CRL is configured, every TLS handshake path serving the etcd client API must reject a peer certificate whose serial number appears in that CRL.
primary_invariant.violated_because: In the split-listener gRPC-only path, TLS handshaking was performed by gRPC without the CRL-checking callback being installed in its TLS configuration.

quality.review_notes: Official advisory and primary/follow-up patch diffs directly establish the split-listener mechanism and mitigation. The regression test establishes an oracle contract only; this bundle contains no test-run result. Exact release-line ancestry of both fixes is not independently verified here.

remediation.invariant_restored: The gRPC-only TLS configuration receives a CRL-verification callback before gRPC server construction; the final callback checks connection peer certificates against the configured CRL and rejects matching serial numbers.
mitigation_classes: install CRL verification in the gRPC TLS configuration
reject peer certificates listed in the configured CRL
regression-test the split HTTP/gRPC listener configuration

state_context.attacker_state_setup: The client possesses a certificate that is listed in the configured CRL and reaches the separately configured gRPC client listener.
data_structure_invariants: The configured CRL must be consulted for peer client certificates on each client-facing TLS handshake path.
A certificate serial listed in the CRL must cause authentication rejection.
state_context.state_machine: Configured CRL and separate HTTP/gRPC listeners -> gRPC-only TLS handshake -> client certificate authentication -> client API access.

target.component: TLS configuration for the gRPC-only client listener path

oracle.expected_negative: A successful etcdctl put using that revoked client certificate would violate the regression-test rejection contract.
oracle.expected_positive: With client TLS, revoked client certificates, a client CA, and separated HTTP/gRPC listeners configured, the revoked-client etcdctl put operation is expected to return an error containing "context deadline exceeded".
